invariants.rationale: The return statement sets result to the maximum of these two quantities.
The result must be at least 200 * delta, by definition of Math.max.
The result must also be at least difference * 7 * delta, by the definition of Math.max.
If delta is not negative, both arguments to Math.max are non-negative, so result must be non-negative.

invariants.expression: difference == 0 || result == 200 * delta || result == difference * 7 * delta
invariants.rationale: If difference is zero, one argument is zero; result must be equal to one of the Math.max arguments.
